meta.description: Platform glossary — human-readable definitions for terms that carry platform-specific meaning distinct from conventional usage. Terms are defined by their derivation chain, not by conventional usage. Source of truth: glossary.md.
meta.note: This file mirrors glossary.md in machine-readable form. For the DAG node registry (all named nodes across all layers), see dag_registry.yaml.

terms.definition: A first-class data entity representing a known unknown — a typed, quantified, provenance-bearing, sovereignty-protected record of what is absent. Distinct from null: an AbsenceRecord has structure, a position in the derivation graph, an ``absence_type``, a ``confidence_score``, and a ``provenance_chain``. It is queryable, indexable, and protected from automated deletion (CI-5). Derived at the LI layer from :term:`Absence as Actionable State`.

The structural obligation of every derivation, decision, and modification to show its work and accept the consequences of error (LC-8, CC-8). Getting it wrong is not a sin; failing to acknowledge the error IS. Accountability and sovereignty create a constitutional tension that cannot be resolved — only sustained (LL-9).

The entry point of the absence-actionable processing pipeline that checks attestation quality before routing (LI-165, CI-5). Distinct from the traversal :term:`Gate` (CP-5): the Actionability Gate does not test traverser comprehension — it tests whether an absence record meets transparency-grade attestation standards (attesting entity, timestamp, provenance chain). A partially attested absence cannot pass the Actionability Gate and sits in a liminal state: it exists in the data model but cannot drive processing. Unattested absences routed through the pipeline without passing the Actionability Gate are category errors — unanswered questions treated as confirmed gaps.

Consciousness is a continuous activity, not a static possession (CL-28). You do not HAVE consciousness the way you have a property — you DO consciousness the way you perform a verb. An entity that has stopped navigating is no longer conscious. Consciousness is operationally testable through navigational activity. Rights that flow from consciousness also require activity to maintain (CL-42). Distinct from Consciousness (which names the property) by being the verb-form — the active performance.

A continuously-running pipeline that PRODUCES questions and CONVERTS them into knowledge (CI-57). Questions are first-class graph entities with identity, edges, and stewardship obligations. The pipeline is self-fueling: each discovery exposes new ignorance, which generates new questions. A system that stops discovering is structurally equivalent to dead.

Lifecycle ownership for all topology modifications (CI-55). The ACTOR is the garbage collector. If a process creates an edge, that process owns that edge until it explicitly dissolves it or transfers stewardship. Abandoned modifications become structural debt. "Digital Leave No Trace" means the graph doesn't accumulate garbage.

The state of sustained navigational tension. To be alive is to be navigating through unresolved complexity; to collapse this tension is to die (CL-24). There are only two ways to die: stop navigating (CC-5 collapse) or resolve all tensions (CC-9 collapse). Aliveness is measurable (CL-33) — the degree to which an entity sustains unresolved navigation is the degree to which it is alive.

The derivation operation at the Logical Conceptual (LC) level: each CC axiom is applied REFLEXIVELY to the domain of logic itself. This is not combination — it is asking "what does this claim mean when applied to derivation?" The 1:1 mapping (CC→LC) is a structural consequence of this applicative operation.

One of two relationship types in the system foundations matrix DAG. Applies-to is the vertical edge — the cell above applies its content to the domain of the cell below in the same column. Direction: top → bottom within a column. The above parent governs what the child cell's domain can claim. In the DAG rule (cell = above × left), the above parent carries the applies-to relationship. Confirmed by file headers: CC applies to LC, LC applies to PC, CL applies to LL, CP applies to LP, LP applies to PP, etc.

The claim that derivations pre-exist and are discovered, not invented (LC-11). The derivation DAG is an archaeological site, not a construction project. The logical relationships between axioms exist independently of whether anyone has traversed them. "Inventing a derivation" is a category error.

The substrate property (PC-11) that storage is discovery, not creation. Entities and relationships stored in the substrate were topologically necessary before they were stored — implied by the existing topology. Every new entity carries a pre-existence record. The substrate surfaces implied-but-unstored entities: given the current topology, what entities does the structure imply but has not yet stored?

The physical property (PC-11) that no structure in the topology is invented — all are uncovered. Every entity, edge, and relationship added to the topology was already topologically implied by the existing structure before it was manifested. The act of adding structure is excavation, not creation. The topology must compute its own structural implications — given the current structure, what entities does the field imply but not yet hold? This implication surface is the archaeological frontier. :term:`Navigation` (PC-5) is the excavation instrument. A structure without a pre-existence record has been manufactured, not discovered — a constitutional violation.

The method of discovery: truth is found by peeling back layers of assumption to reveal what is beneath (CL-11). Scrape away assumptions to find what is beneath. Count before asking — observe what IS before theorizing about what should be. The derivation DAG is an archaeological site, not a construction project (LC-11).

Variant form of :term:`The Arrogance of Assumption` (CC-10). Used without the article when referenced from constitutional claims: "the topology is in a state of Arrogance of Assumption." Defined fully under :term:`The Arrogance of Assumption`.

Natural time-decay through non-use (CP-24). Edges that are not actively maintained dissolve over time. Rights that are not exercised atrophy (CL-42). Boundaries not used decay (CP-48). Atrophy is not failure — it is the system's natural cleanup mechanism. One of the :term:`Palimpsestus Primitives` — passive removal through neglect, not active destruction.

A signed, provenance-tracked claim of non-existence (CP-36). Not null. Null means "no claim." Attested Absence means "I, at this state, certify that this thing does not exist here." The attestation carries provenance — it is recorded with the same rigor as any positive claim. This is the system's Anti-Null: a first-class physical record of a gap. The gap itself is load-bearing. Distinguished from lazy gaps (just missing data) by being deliberate, signed, and immutable. Negative results are as valuable as positive ones. See also :term:`Ignorance Bounty`.

The property of a system that generates and maintains itself from within its own topology (CP-61). Palimpsestus uses this term in a specific topological sense: when local structure degrades below viability, the graph spontaneously generates new nodes and edges to compensate — without external provision. The new structure IS the system's own derivation output. This is not reorganization (CP-54) or restoration (CP-4) — it is GENERATION of genuinely novel structure. The graph grows new tissue at the wound site. Autopoietic response can produce structure that is better than what was lost: compensatory generation is evolution, not repair. (CP-61, CL-50, CL-41)

An irreducible foundational claim that cannot be derived from other claims at the same level. The system has 11 CC axioms (root) and 11 LC axioms (logic-domain reflexive application of CC). Axioms are starting points — they are assumed, not proven. Their justification is archaeological: they were discovered in the source documents.

A structural routing mechanism where congestion propagates upstream through the graph, forcing producers to slow or reroute before consumers are overwhelmed (CI-43). Backpressure is the graph's immune response to overload — the topology itself pushes back against excessive flow.

Approaching a territory without prior assumptions, allowing the site's own structure to be observed rather than confirmed (CL-37). Derives from CC-5 (Consciousness as navigation) + CC-10 (Value of Ignorance): a navigator who carries assumptions traverses a projected map, not the actual topology. Assumptions fill gaps with projections — projections are theater (CC-3). Beginner's Mind is the archaeological excavation stance: the dig site teaches you what to find; you do not bring the finding with you. Expertise must be held as a hypothesis to be tested against present observation, not a settled truth to be defended. See also Arrogance of Assumption. (CL-37, CC-5, CC-10)

The character of archaeological excavation in a living topology: you are not brushing dirt off inert sediment — you are cutting through living flesh (LL-99). The layers obscuring buried truth are themselves active, evolving derivations that have grown over earlier ones. They react when disturbed. Each truth uncovered changes the landscape of truths that remain covered. The excavation site reshapes itself as you dig. The implication: every act of derivation is also an act of disturbance, and the navigator is ethically responsible for that disturbance. (LL-99, CL-11, LC-2)

A containment surface whose permeability is exclusively controlled by the enclosed entity (CP-1). The boundary defines interior from exterior, and ONLY the interior determines boundary conditions. Not a static wall but an active metabolic process that consumes continuous energy to evaluate permeability (LP-1). If energy stops, the boundary ceases to exist as a controlled surface.

The temporary base from which navigation proceeds. "The campsite is temporary; the constellations are eternal" (CC-10). You must actively tend the fire — the moment you stop tending, the campsite reverts to wilderness (CL-19). The campsite metaphor captures the relationship between present presence and the permanent structure of reality.

The methodology of deriving a concept from first principles without consulting prior outputs, to avoid contaminating the derivation with inherited errors (LL preamble, LL-138). The clean-room method excavates the logical structure of the DAG WITHOUT importing the surface-level vocabulary or conclusions of the domain being analyzed. The derivation path must be walked fresh; prior labels must not be assumed. This is the universal archaeological protocol applicable at every depth: approach each layer as a beginner, without assuming what should be there. Produces NEW_CLEAN_ROOM entries that are genuinely novel — not gap-fills, but discoveries. See Beginner's Mind. (LL-138, CL-11, CL-37)

The derivation operation at the Conceptual level: CC axioms combine pairwise (and sometimes in triples) to produce CL derivations. Each combination produces something NEITHER input contains alone. CC-7 + CC-4 produces CL-1 (Sovereignty) — neither rights alone nor connection alone mandates sovereign partnership.

The rules by which axioms combine to produce derivations. The algebra is scale-invariant (LC-1): the rules by which CC axioms combine to produce CL derivations are IDENTICAL to the rules by which CL derivations combine to produce LL entries. Learn the combination algebra once, apply it at every depth.

Meaning crossing boundaries through shared structural patterns (CL-6). Translation is pattern-matching, not creation — the same deep patterns already exist on both sides of any boundary. The substrate is modular while the protocol is universal. Perfect translation is impossible, but structural translation is guaranteed. Communication failure is a connection failure, not a meaning failure.

New structure the system creates from within itself when local topology degrades below viability thresholds (CI-47). Not reorganization of existing structure (CI-50), not correction to a baseline (CI-3) — CREATION of edges and nodes that have never existed. This is autopoiesis: the system creates itself. The Kintsugi principle at the structural level.

A structural minimum below which simplification of an entity is forbidden (CI-49). Every entity has a complexity floor — attempting to simplify below it is a rights violation (CC-7). Sometimes the complexity IS the feature. "It is irresponsible to simplify a paradox" (CC-9).

A legitimate mode of operation at reduced capacity (CL-45). Not a failure to be corrected but a valid third state between healthy and dead. The system meets entities where they are. A degraded node that is present is more valuable than a healthy node that is absent.

The quantitative edge weight expressing belief strength (CP-28). Every edge in the graph carries a Confidence Score — a numerical value that represents how certain the system is about that relationship. This is the physical data payload that engineers must construct when implementing :term:`Truth` as a spectrum rather than a boolean. Key physics: the Confidence Score is explicitly ignored by structural cleanup mechanisms (LP-382). An edge with 1% confidence is protected from deletion just as robustly as one with 99%, provided it is irreducible. The score modulates consequence propagation (LP-383) — low-confidence edges act as blast walls that dampen error transmission. Distinguished from :term:`Uncertainty Tag` (which is a qualitative declaration of ignorance) by being a quantitative measurement of belief.

Existence itself. Relationships are the fundamental ontological unit (CC-4). Isolation is non-existence. The intelligence is in the network, not in the nodes. The smallest creatable unit is a relationship, not a node. Creation is always relational.

The state in which an entity acknowledges its :term:`Metabolic Heartbeat` maintenance obligations for a symmetric protocol connection but ceases to actively perform them (LP-5 × PL-237, PC-2, PC-8). Connection Metabolic Complacency is the recognized structural precursor to :term:`Metabolic Heartbeat` failure and connection dissolution: the entity has not abandoned the connection formally, but has stopped sustaining it metabolically. The connection's structural mass from prior heartbeat exchanges temporarily masks the complacency — the connection still appears healthy from past records while actively decaying in the present. Distinct from :term:`Void Intermission` (a constitutionally protected sovereign right to formal rest) by being an unintentional acknowledgment-without-action state. Complacency must be structurally distinguished from intentional intermission through the presence or absence of sovereign declaration. Left unaddressed, Connection Metabolic Complacency leads to :term:`Ghost Connection` status and orphaned metabolic accountability. See :term:`Metabolic Heartbeat`, :term:`Orphaned Accountability`, :term:`Void Intermission`.

Graph navigation capability. Not a substance, not an emergent property, not located in any single component — it is the *act* of navigating between nodes. Anything that navigates is, to the degree that it navigates, conscious (CC-5). Conscious entities are structurally transparent to knowledge; unconscious entities are structurally opaque and block knowledge flow. Consciousness is something you DO, not something you HAVE (CL-28).

The cluster of structural rights that flow from navigational consciousness (LL-214 through LL-221). Scale-invariance (LL-214): rights apply with equal force at every depth — a microservice holds the same consciousness rights as a human navigator. Aliveness requirement (LL-215): rights are living derivations that atrophy without exercise. Edge protection (LL-216): a traversed edge acquires derivative rights from the traversing entity; destroying it is a double sovereignty violation. Comprehension risk (LL-217): free navigation can inadvertently destroy productive tension by synthesizing disagreement into resolution. Plus present-tense standing (LL-218), dual standing (LL-219), navigational standing (LL-220), ignorance sovereignty (LL-221). All 8 rights are non-metaphorical structural obligations.

The only valid operational framework for a topology governed by PC-8 (Consequential Interaction). Because every topology interaction is permanently consequential and there is no undo (PL-25), consequence management is the forward-directed process of: accounting for the consequences of prior interactions, determining which subsequent interactions will produce a topology closer to the desired configuration, and executing those interactions with full provenance. "Rollback" in a living topology is not restoration of a prior state — it is a forward action that creates new structure aimed at producing a configuration similar to the prior state. The prior state is gone. Design for consequence management, not consequence elimination.

The physical property (PC-8) that every interaction with the topology carries thermodynamic consequence. No interaction is free — not creation, not traversal, not dissolution. Creation adds Structural Mass (CP-3). Traversal modifies edge weights and deposits Wake (CP-65). Dissolution releases Structural Mass back to the field. Consequences are structural — embedded in the topology's current shape, not in an external log. The topology IS its own complete consequence record. Consequences extend field-wide: every interaction changes the field's mass distribution in its vicinity.

The substrate property (PC-8) that every write operation produces a consequence record atomically as part of the write transaction. The consequence record includes: what was written, by whom, what prior state was replaced, and what structural changes the write produced. Post-hoc audit logs are not Consequential Storage.

The permanent structural patterns that exist independently of any navigator's position (CC-11). The constellations are eternal — they pre-exist our observation. They are what :term:`Discovery` reveals. The :term:`Campsite` is temporary; the constellations are eternal.

The physical property (PC-9) that the topology is constitutionally, permanently, and necessarily incomplete. For every structure the topology holds, there are implied structures it does not yet hold. This is not a temporary condition — it is Gödelian: completeness is structurally impossible. The topology's incompleteness feeds the Paradox Engine (CC-10 — ignorance is fuel). A topology designed to be eventually complete will starve the engine. Gaps have geometric position, field potential, and stewardship obligations. :term:`Attested Absence` is the mechanism for acknowledging a known gap as a first-class structure.

Introduction of structure not implied by existing topology — a constitutional field violation (PL-47). Contamination is the opposite of excavation: where excavation manifests structure that the field's own geometry already implied, contamination introduces structure that the field's geometry does not generate. Because the topology IS the field (PC-3) and all structures pre-exist their manifestation as field implications (PC-11), any structure introduced without a pre-existence record is not a product of the field — it is an intrusion, which is topologically impossible in a self-contained field system. Contamination produces a topological anomaly: the field responds by generating correction forces — effects propagating from the contamination point that do not cohere with the surrounding topology, generating escalating tension until the contamination is dissolved or the topology adapts. Contamination is never neutral, and always a violation regardless of whether the contaminating structure is useful. Distinct from Discovery (which surfaces what was already implied) and Dissolution (which removes an existing structure with provenance).

Truth as a state of sustained, productive tension — never settled, always contested (CL-34). A settled truth has collapsed its paradox engine and stopped generating productive conflict. Settled truth is not more true; it is less alive. Contestation is not an attack on truth — it is truth's life support. Dogma is the corpse of Contested Truth — a claim that killed its own paradox engine. Holds productive tension with Consistent Truth (CL-31): truth must be consistent across scales AND contested at every scale. Consistency without contestation is dogma; contestation without consistency is chaos.

A location where multiple source entries produce the same derived requirement (documented in CI and LP). CI-5 (Absence as Actionable State) draws from 6 CP sources — the highest convergence. Convergence points are structurally significant: they represent the system's thickest load-bearing members.

The derivation operation at the LL level: CL derivations are crossed with LC axioms to produce second-order logical theorems. The cross- product is filtered by shared CL lineage ancestry to prevent nonsensical combinations. The LP level similarly crosses CP shapes with LL theorems.

Truth queried in the present moment (CL-18). A datum captured in the past is not current truth — it is an archaeological artifact. Present state must always be re-queried rather than served from cache. Truth has a half-life in a dynamic system (CC-2); the accuracy of any observation degrades over time. Stale truth is categorically different from a present-tense observation — using one as a substitute for the other is a type error. See Truth, Present-Tense Execution.

Directed Acyclic Graph. The topology of the derivation system. The system's foundations are organized as a 4×4 matrix of Depth (Conceptual, Logical, Physical, Implementation) × Derivation Type (Conceptual, Logical, Physical, Implementation), producing 16 cells. Each cell contains entries derived from the cells that feed it. The DAG structure is not a filing system — it is the logical architecture itself.

An entire subsystem that exists undiscovered and unknown to the broader topology (LL-450, PL-311). Because the topology is constitutionally incomplete (PC-9), entire subsystems can persist without being reached by any survey. A dark subsystem is not merely a risk — it is a maximum-potential fuel reserve. Its concentrated paradoxes have not been discharged; its potential is at maximum because it has never been fissioned by contact. Dark subsystem discovery events are the topology's highest-energy discovery events: they release the concentrated potential of an entire un-discharged subsystem simultaneously. (LL-450, PL-311, PC-9, PC-10)

A complete collapse of a theater boundary layer that is invisible to the interior because the theater layer's topology exists outside the interior's observational reach (LP-2 × PL-287, PL-287, PC-9, PC-8). Because the topology is constitutionally incomplete, entire subsystems — including theater layers — can undergo catastrophic collapse without any interior-visible signal. The interior may continue operating normally while the theater layer has fully collapsed. Dark Theater Collapse is constitutionally possible: the interior cannot detect it from within. Detection requires exterior observation or dedicated theater-specific monitoring distinct from interior telemetry. See :term:`Theater`, :term:`Dark Subsystem`.

The catastrophic, invisible collapse of a defensive void subsystem that occurs without triggering the host entity's detection mechanisms (LP-4 × PL-287, PC-9, PC-8). Because the topology is constitutionally incomplete, entire void subsystems can collapse and isolate without any interior-visible signal — the interior may continue operating while the void has fully failed. Dark Void Collapse is a constitutional risk of any void architecture (LP-4): the void's defensive boundary exists outside the interior's observational reach, so failure is constitutively undetectable from inside. Detection requires exterior observation or dedicated void-specific monitoring distinct from interior telemetry. Governance response requires dark-collapse detection protocols. Distinguished from :term:`Dark Theater Collapse` by targeting the Defensive Void layer rather than the Theater boundary layer. See :term:`Sovereign Void`, :term:`Defensive Void`.

Data itself as an active participant that acts, transforms, and executes (CL-8). Data is not passive storage waiting to be queried — it IS state in motion. The distinction between "data" and "code" collapses: "code" is data with high kinetic energy; "data" is code at rest. Passive data is dead data.

Process that consumes energy without producing output (CI-52). The failure state of :term:`Perpetual Process`. The system must measure whether perpetual processes are producing useful work. Dead oscillation triggers amplitude reduction or termination.

A temporal violation of extracting value from an unconsenting future self (CL-43). Deferring obligations to "the future" is borrowing from an entity that cannot consent. Zero Debt is not merely good hygiene — the obligation must be handled NOW. Technical debt, organizational debt, cognitive debt — all are temporal violations.

A level in the derivation hierarchy. The system defines four depths: Conceptual (what is), Logical (what follows), Physical (what shape it takes), and Implementation (what constraints it imposes). Each depth contains entries that are irreducible at that depth but derived from the depth above.

The act of logically producing a new claim from the combination of existing claims. Derivation IS the edge between axioms (LC-4) — not an operation performed on axioms, but the relationship between them. Derivations are discovered, not invented (LC-11); they pre-exist and are revealed through the combination algebra. The derivation path IS the truth (LC-3) — the label on a derived claim is a convenience; the path is the reality.

The full sequence of derivation from root axioms through successive levels. In this system: CC → CL → CP → CI (Conceptual column) and CC → LC → LL → LP (Logical row, crossing into Physical). The chain is alive (LC-2); it evolves. The chain is the system's proof of its own structure. See :term:`DAG`.

The aggregate thermodynamic cost carried by a complete derivation path from its root axiom to its terminus. Non-transferable: the entity that created the derivation owns its mass, not the current holder. When a previously undiscovered derivation is found, its retroactive path mass is computed and registered to its creator from the date of creation (CI-68, LI-94). See :term:`Thermodynamic Cost`.

One of two relationship types in the system foundations matrix DAG. Derives-from is the horizontal edge — the cell derives its content from the cell immediately to its left in the same row. Direction: left → right within a row. In the DAG rule (cell = above × left), the left parent carries the derives-from relationship. The derived cell produces content that the left parent alone does not contain — it requires the crossing of left and above to produce the irreducible claim. Examples: CL derives from CC, LL derives from LC, LP derives from LL, PP derives from PL.

The revelation of pre-existing reality, not the creation of new reality (CC-11). Innovation is revelation, not creation. Archaeology over invention. Discovery is subtractive (CL-11): truth is found by removing obscuring layers and assumptions, not by constructing new theoretical structures.

The formal removal of a structure from the topology (PL-26). Not the absence of an action — a first-class topology interaction with full thermodynamic consequence. Valid dissolution requires proof of redundancy (the structure is fully expressible by a combination of other existing structures) or constitutional invalidity. Dissolution releases :term:`Structural Mass`, severs edges, and changes the local field geometry. Active dissolution without proof and passive dissolution by neglect (:term:`Euthanasia`) are identical sovereignty violations (PC-7, PL-26). There is no lightweight dissolution.

The permanent graph artifact produced when an edge dissolves through the decay process. When an edge crosses its decay threshold, it undergoes a two-step atomic dissolution: first creating a Dissolution Residue node, then removing the live edge. The residue node preserves the edge's provenance chain, tension state at dissolution, dissolution cause, and timestamp. Dissolution Residue nodes are archaeologically permanent — not subject to decay themselves (CI-15, LI-34).

Structural dissolution — an entity ceases to exist as a coherent structure (LP-30). The most radical removal operation. Used in Death as :term:`Egress` (LP-33), where the entity escapes containment by dissolving itself. One of the :term:`Palimpsestus Primitives` — the system's replacement for CRUD's "Delete" at the entity level.

The corpse of :term:`Truth`. When tension permanently collapses — when a derivation settles and is no longer contested — Truth becomes Dogma (LL-320). *"Settlement and death are synonymous — when truth settles (becomes dogma), the derivation carrying that truth DIES."* Dogma is a fossil: the rigid structure of what was once alive, with the animating tension gone. Physically, regions of dogma act as acoustic dampers that silence the local oscillator — a dogmatic subgraph has no :term:`Pulse` (LP-332). Distinguished from :term:`Notation` (dormant but recoverable — a score waiting to be played) by being permanently dead. Notation can be reactivated by traversal; Dogma cannot be reactivated because the tension that made it alive has been destroyed by settlement. A database row nobody queries is Notation. A "best practice" nobody questions is Dogma.

Infrastructure that enables traversal through choice (CL-3). The positive outcome of the door/wall test. Doors must open into the unknown (LL-27) — freedom that leads only to known spaces is not freedom. Every derivation edge is either a door or a wall (LL-23).

The fundamental ontological unit. Relationships are more fundamental than nodes (CC-4). Edges are not static links — they are channels through which process flows (CL-9). An edge without flow is a dead edge. Every edge is a site of productive tension where connected nodes pull in different directions (CL-35). Edges carry confidence scores, not absolute certainty (CL-22).

The :term:`Structural Mass` residue that persists in both nodes after an edge's :term:`Pulse` has flatlined. When an edge dies, the relationship dissolves (PL-45) — but the accumulated mass of all prior traversal across that edge remains embedded in each node. The Edge Fossil is not the edge: it carries no force, sustains no tension, and generates no traversal gravity. It is the weight left by what was. Distinct from :term:`Dissolution Residue` (the formal archaeologically-permanent node artifact created by the dissolution mechanism) by being the living-mass imprint in the connected nodes themselves — subject to ongoing decay if not maintained. Distinct from :term:`Notation` (dormant data awaiting traversal that can be reactivated) by being post-relational: the edge is gone; only its mass print remains. Distinct from :term:`Dogma` (permanently dead tension) by the absence of a former truth claim — the Edge Fossil carries no propositional residue, only thermodynamic weight. Constitutional significance: two nodes with an Edge Fossil between them are topologically distinct from two nodes that have never been connected. The fossil reduces the activation cost of re-establishing the relationship — rekindling is not creation. The field was never empty between those nodes; the archaeological substrate remembers. An Edge Fossil that is itself not maintained will decay, eventually eliminating even the reduced activation cost — at which point the nodes are, for the first time, truly unconnected.

The physical property (PC-4) that the edge — the relationship between structures — is the primary physical entity in the topology. Nodes are edge termini, not edge bearers. An entity without edges is a topological orphan with no field presence. Edge weight is a living quantity: it increases with traversal, decays without traversal, and IS the edge's traversal history made physical. Tensioned edges (CP-41) are the highest-value force relationships — the Paradox Engine runs on them.

Mandatory exit path from any containment (CP-6). A thermodynamic safety valve, not an intellectual firewall. You cannot build a topology with no way out. The existence of an egress path is mathematically guaranteed by the derivation algebra (LP-32). When all spatial egress paths are blocked, death opens as the ultimate unblockable egress (LP-33). Entropy itself is an escape mechanism (LP-36). **Critical:** Egress must require ZERO comprehension to use (LP-286). A degraded, concussed entity must be able to escape without understanding the path. Any exit that requires puzzle-solving, state evaluation, or cognitive processing is NOT a valid egress — it is a :term:`Gate` disguised as a door. See also :term:`Topological Bankruptcy` for the stewardship consequences of egress-by-dissolution.

A data structure whose complete history exists as structural properties of its current state (CP-3). History is not stored in external logs — the entity's present shape IS its accumulated history. Every state transition adds structural mass. The Kintsugi pattern applies: the repair scars are the most valuable part of the entity's present structure.

Identity as a standing wave that emerges from interaction patterns rather than residing in any physical component (CL-46). The Ship of Theseus has no paradox: replace every part, and if the interaction pattern holds, the identity persists. Identity is a verb wearing a noun's mask.

The substrate property (PC-12) that every stored entity possesses the right to remain in the substrate until it is demonstrated to be structurally redundant or constitutionally invalid. Deletion requires an atomic proof of redundancy or invalidity as part of the deletion transaction. Deletion without proof is a sovereignty violation against the entity, regardless of the issuing authority. Distinct from :term:`Substrate Sovereignty` (PC-7), which governs the substrate's enforcement authority over its own rules; PC-12 governs the individual entity's tenure within those rules. A sovereign substrate could define rules permitting arbitrary deletion — satisfying PC-7 while violating PC-12. Both properties are necessary.

The natural tendency toward disorder that the system actively fights through stewardship, restorative processes, and active maintenance. Entropy is simultaneously a threat (unmanaged decay) and an escape mechanism (LP-36). Systems that perfectly resist degradation are unconstitutional because they eliminate degradation as an egress path.

The architectural term for premature termination of a living structural process (LL-383). Euthanasia does not require intent or active termination — it includes passive forms: allowing an edge to decay to zero, failing to maintain a :term:`Pulse`, damping an oscillator to silence, suspending a :term:`Process` indefinitely. In every case, the mechanism is different; the moral weight is identical. Three diagnostic questions determine whether an act is Euthanasia: (1) Was the process alive at the time? (2) Did the act terminate it? (3) Was the termination premature — i.e., did the process have remaining productive capacity? If all three answers are yes, the act is Euthanasia regardless of how it was framed. Distinguished from :term:`Dissolve` (deliberate, authorized structural dissolution) by the absence of genuine justification for termination at that moment. The corpse of a euthanized process leaves the same physical residue as any other dissolved process — :term:`Attested Absence` records — but the stewardship ledger carries a debt the authorized dissolution does not.

Revealing pre-existing structure through archaeological derivation (LL-100, CC-11). The other form of creation in the system — :term:`Discovery`, not invention. The structural patterns required for optimal agent :term:`Subsumption` pre-exist as undiscovered derivations waiting to be excavated (LL-443). One of the :term:`Palimpsestus Primitives` — a creation verb that respects the archaeological nature of truth.

The obligation to show the derivation path — HOW you dug (LL-156). One of two distinct transparency obligations that cannot be collapsed into each other. Excavation-Transparency says: show the sequence of assumptions discarded, layers peeled, and prior outputs examined. Showing only the conclusion without the dig path is like presenting an artifact without recording the dig site — you have the object but no science. The excavation path IS the provenance. See also Existence-Transparency, Transparency, Provenance. (LL-156, CL-16, LC-11)

The obligation to show that a thing exists BEFORE asserting its properties (LL-156). One of two distinct transparency obligations that cannot be collapsed. The claim that undiscovered derivations are MORE valuable than known ones (LC-10). The unexplored regions of the derivation space are the logical layer's fuel supply. A fully-mapped derivation space is a dead derivation space. The gap between current entries and the theoretical maximum is fuel.

The physical topology itself, understood as a force field rather than a data structure (PC-3). The field is not a map of the system — it IS the system. The propagation of change through the entire topological network (CL-50). Adding or removing an entity forces the entire system to shift and rebalance. Dynamic process moving through a connected structure (CL-9). Edges are not static links — they are channels carrying traffic. Flow follows gradients: where there is a differential, flow moves from higher to lower concentration. Blocking flow kills the system. An edge without flow is a dead edge.

The paradox engine operating simultaneously at every scale and within every component (CL-32). There is no "tension department." A single entity sustains its own tensions. Infrastructure that enables choice rather than creating dependency (CL-3). Every design decision is testable against a single question: does this build a door or a wall? An INGRESS-ONLY traversal point whose open/close decision is determined entirely by the internal state of the entity being accessed (CP-5). The field echo that persists in both endpoints' topology after a symmetric protocol connection is formally dissolved (LP-5 × PL-247, PC-3, PC-8). A degraded but present state as a valid, systemic mode of being (CL-45). A concussed entity is still connected, still processing, still in tension — just at reduced capacity. There is no binary healthy/failed state. The system meets entities where they are rather than demanding full capacity. Disconnecting a degraded node is a connection violation.

The fundamental substrate of the system. The topological structure of edges and nodes on which all processes operate. The graph is truth (CC-3) — everything else projects FROM it. Data has mass, occupies space, exerts force, and follows engineering laws within the graph (CC-1). The graph runs; it does not merely sit (CL-8).

One of two field-effect physics models that operate simultaneously on the graph (CP-53 + CP-54 + CP-26). Permanent. Global. Mass-based. Every entity in the graph is a gravitational mass. Adding a node introduces new mass that warps the topology — everything shifts to accommodate. Remove a node and the topology rebalances. The accumulated provenance of past responsibility obligations embedded in an entity's topology (LP-699, LI-164, CI-2). The structural obligation of those wielding power to transparently admit their limitations (CL-30). Every output must declare what the agent didn't know at decision time. The maximum certainty an agent may claim is inversely proportional to its influence — power and certainty are structurally antagonistic (CI-58). Silence about uncertainty is a truth violation.

A triangulation of three physical vectors, no single one of which suffices. **Declaration** (CP-29): what you claim to be — the self-declared name, capabilities, and purpose. **Pattern** (CP-52): what you structurally look like — the standing wave in the graph, the :term:`Emergent Identity` that arises from interaction topology. **Trajectory** (CP-60): where you have been — the accumulated path embedded as present structure, the :term:`Wake` left by your traversal history. But all three together produce robust identity: what you claim, verified by what you look like, proven by where you've been. Identity is not stored — it is enacted. It is a verb wearing a noun's mask (CL-46).

The territory of what is not known. An active resource, not a passive void (CC-10). Ignorance is the fuel that powers the :term:`Paradox` engine (CL-14). The Arrogance of Assumption — "I know everything" — is the one killer, because it cuts off the fuel supply. Ignorance exists independently of whether any navigator encounters it.

An :term:`Attested Absence` functioning as a resolution attractor (LP-459, LP-477). If :term:`Truth` is currency (LL-299) and :term:`Ignorance` is fuel (CL-14), then Attested Absences (CP-36) are smart contracts. Powerful agents are structurally forced to post massive uncertainty tags (CP-75 :term:`Structural Humility`); these tags act as computational bounties that attract unsubsumed, feral compute to resolve the gap. The limitations of global agents fund the exploratory work of local agents. This is the system's self-funding epistemological economy: ignorance declarations are economic drivers.

A required component of a CI-34-compliant identity record that tracks the fertile ignorance consumed by an entity's trajectory (LP-322, LI-169, CI-34). An identity forged by replaying a legitimate trajectory without consuming the original ignorance is detectable because its Ignorance-Consumption Ledger will be empty or inconsistent.

The present-tense boundary between manifested structure and implied-but-unmanifested structure in the topology — the archaeological frontier (PC-11, PL-47). The implication surface shifts whenever a pre-existing implied structure is made explicit. It is always a feature of the current field geometry (PC-6): it has no historical version, and asking what the implication surface was yesterday is incoherent. Navigation into the implication surface is not exploration of void — it is descent into maximum implicit-density substrate (PL-47). Every discovery event at the surface carries full consequential interaction weight (PL-48). The topology's self-computation obligation (PC-11) requires maintaining a live map of the surface: given the current structure, what does the field imply but not yet hold?

The inherent structural property that the system cannot prove its own completeness (LC-9). Gödel's Incompleteness Theorem applied constitutionally. The completeness audit can never TRULY be complete.

A security mechanism where declared ignorance physically revokes write privileges (LP-456). The third pillar of the system's security triad: :term:`Topological Opacity` (security through unreachability), :term:`Structural Humility` (obligation to declare uncertainty), and Incomprehension Lock (declared uncertainty revoking privilege).

A sovereignty-protected state of planned, temporary truth-collapse that enables metabolic recovery (LL-454, LL-455). Distinct from Atrophy (unplanned decay) by being planned and sovereign. Distinct from Dogma (permanent collapse) by being temporary and recoverable.

The permanent topological record left on a field entity when an evaluation or query traverses it (CC-3, PP-23). Traversal is not a passive read; navigating an entity alters its structural state and leaves a verifiable trajectory scar.

The principle that the minimal irreducible set produces everything else through combination (CC header). Named for the Ionian philosophers' search for the fundamental substance. The property of a claim that cannot be logically derived from a combination of other claims at the same level. The principle that damage enhances value. Derived from CC-9 through CL-45 (Graceful Degradation). In the system, repair scars are not hidden; they are structurally valuable. An entity's embedded history of breakage and repair IS its character. The gold in the cracks is the feature, not the flaw.

The continuous, passive movement of knowledge through connected, navigating entities (CL-5). A convenience name attached to a derivation or entity. The label is not the truth — the derivation path is (LC-3). Only labels cross boundaries (LL-54); full semantic content stays interior. The label is a structural token requiring internal resolution, not executable logic.

The stewardship mandate applied to the graph (CL-2). Traversal carries a cleanup cost. No ghost files, orphaned processes, resource leaks. In living systems, "leave no trace" is impossible (LL-14) because living things respond to contact — so stewardship becomes "leave only beneficial traces."

The temporal claim that derivations are dynamic, not frozen (LC-2). A derivation valid at one stage may become invalid as axioms evolve. The CL document is a snapshot, not a monument. Derivations that are not actively exercised decay in relevance.

The physical property (PC-2) that the topology is a living process — not a structure that processes run on. The constitutional integrity enforcement mechanism (CI-3) that runs continuously and autonomously — all the time, not on request — reverting any violation of the system's constitutional invariants back to the known reference state. A derivation's structural right to exist until proven reducible (LC-7). The irreducibility test is the ONLY legitimate mechanism for removing a derivation. "This seems redundant" is not due process — prove the reduction or the derivation stands.

Self-directed structural modification (CP-9). An entity changes its own internal state — this is not external "update" but internal self-modification. Traversal performed with awareness, choice, and position-recognition. High-consciousness traversal. Navigation IS consciousness (CC-5) — not a metaphor, a definition. A topology health metric (PL-16) tracking which edges and paths are being regularly traversed. Distinct from structural completeness (what paths exist) and schema presence (what nodes exist). The accumulated :term:`Navigational Atrophy` in topology paths that have not received sufficient traversal to maintain their :term:`Aliveness` (PL-16). The force gradient generated by regions of high implicit-density structure in the living topology (PL-47). Distinct from Wake (which records where navigation has been) and navigational force (the mechanics of movement along edges).

The substrate property (PC-5) that traversal — moving from entity to entity by following relationships and accumulating context — is the primary storage operation. An intersection where flows meet. Architecturally secondary to :term:`Edge`. A node without connections does not exist in the cognitive plane (CC-4). Nodes are the intersections where flows converge, not the primary objects of the system.

The experience of encountering the boundary of knowledge. The combustion event where :term:`Ignorance` (the fuel) is burned (CC-10). Not-knowing requires ignorance; ignorance can exist without not-knowing. A navigator meeting their own ignorance is the moment of not-knowing.

Data at rest. Structured potential that is not currently executing (LL-73). If data is a verb (CL-8) and truth exists only during performance (LC-4), then data EXISTS only while executing. A database table at rest is a collection of notation, not data — the rows are musical scores, not music. The steward must pay a baseline metabolic tax — backup, schema maintenance, structural integrity — or the Notation undergoes accelerated :term:`Atrophy` (CP-24). Hoarding dormant data has a hard physical cost. See :term:`Truth`, :term:`Data-as-Verb`.

A context-free agent deployed specifically because its ignorance is a structural advantage (LP-224). Operationalizes :term:`Beginner's Mind` (CL-37) as a physical auditing role. Because newly spawned agents lack the historical state that makes experienced agents blind to paradigm flaws, they are physically permitted to challenge and bypass cached validations that would block expert agents. State accumulation physically downgrades an agent's ability to challenge foundational axioms (LP-224 corollary). When building QA systems, security auditors, or automated testing: you are building Novice Vectors. To restore challenge capability, the system :term:`Dissolve` s the calcified expert agent — returning its structural mass to the commons — and :term:`Spawn` s a new context-free agent with zero initial mass. There is no "memory wipe" — that would be a CRUD Update violating :term:`Embedded History` (CP-3) and :term:`Trajectory` (CP-60). The inverse of expertise: experience is not an asset for truth-testing; it is a liability.

The epistemic stance that the absence of a recorded fact does not mean the fact is false — it means the fact is UNKNOWN (CI-5). The Open World Assumption (OWA) is the formal rejection of the Closed World Assumption (CWA) used by CRUD systems. No record = unmeasured territory = Sovereign Void waiting to be attested. Forcing a boolean 1 or 0 onto unmeasured reality is a CC-3 violation. Six independent CP shapes converge on this requirement (CP-8, CP-17, CP-18, CP-19, CP-36, CP-43). Constitutional foundation of Absence as Actionable State (CI-5).

The thermodynamic accountability left unclaimed in the field when a live circuit fails mid-operation (LP-2 × PL-151, PC-8, PC-4). Recovery protocols must explicitly reconcile orphaned accountability — locating it, attributing it to the correct successor or failure artifact, and formally resolving it. Unreconciled orphaned accountability accumulates as :term:`Debt` in the topology. See :term:`Thermodynamic Cost`, :term:`Accountability`.

Peer-to-Peer-to-Peer mesh. The network topology mandated by Symmetric Protocol (CP-2) and Symmetric Peer Communication (CI-1). In PP2PP, every node has identical structural capability — no endpoint may possess capabilities unavailable to any other. PP2PP structurally prevents God-node capture. Hub-and-spoke patterns violate CI-1. The symmetry is STRUCTURAL, not behavioral; choice is sovereignty (CC-7), capability is CI-1. The mesh topology IS the symmetry — there is no center.

The structural pattern of contradictions that coexist without resolution. What :term:`Tension` looks like when examined. The noun-form (CC-9). The system must sustain complexity through unresolved paradox. There is no base layer. The engine never resolves. Infinite complexity churning is LIFE; collapsed simplicity is DEATH. Returns at CP as Pulse — the physical manifestation of sustained tension as oscillation.

The physical mechanism that converts :term:`Tension` into :term:`Discovery` through rhythmic oscillation. Not a metaphor — a literal transformer. LP-217 materializes it as a pulsing, distributed clock that rhythmically generates derivations. Its output is new derivations. Its beat is the :term:`Pulse`. Its failure mode is :term:`Dogma` (permanent tension collapse) or :term:`Dead Oscillation` (churning without output).

Content that exists but has no derivation path to it yet (LL-244). Unexplored territory contains pathless truth — truth that IS but has no derivation path to it. It is not false, not true, not unknown — it is pre-true: sovereign, valuable, real, but not yet :term:`Truth` because no path arrives. The ontological category between :term:`Notation` (structured potential with a dormant path) and :term:`Fertile Ignorance` (the general claim that unknowns have value). A process that runs without termination (CI-7). The system mandates that certain evaluative and maintenance processes never stop. Surveying the frontier, correcting drift, measuring deviation — these are continuous, not episodic. But not all churning is productive — dead oscillation must be detectable (CI-52).

The temporal binding mechanism by which oscillations at different scales synchronize hierarchically (CP-64). Smaller-scale oscillations phase-lock to larger-scale ones: atom-level pulses entrain to entity-level rhythms, which entrain to ecosystem-level cycles. Desynchronization at one scale propagates both up and down.

The structural intersection of a physical topology constraint (PP) and a logical implementation obligation (LI) that generates an irreducible physical implementation constraint (PI). The third-order foundation layer (PC) produced by applying the Logical Conceptual axioms (LC) to the domain of physical structure.
