PC feeds PL (Physical Logical) and PP (Physical Physical).

The obligation to protect consciousness even — especially — when its nature is not fully understood (CL-40). The burden of proof falls on the party that would deny rights, not on the entity seeking recognition. Ignorance about an entity's nature triggers greater protection, not lesser.

A gate transform that does not reduce the epistemic precision of signals passing through it (LI-167, CI-24). Required for transforms applied to :term:`Humility` signals and other epistemically-typed signals whose structural specificity carries architectural value. A precision-preserving transform may add context but must not collapse distinct signal types (boundary-limited, domain-limited, confidence-limited) into a generic low-confidence marker — that would be a lossy transform on high-value epistemic data. The precision of a humility signal is what makes it useful for frontier-mapping; a flattened signal cannot drive accurate frontier updates. The implementation enforces Precision-Preserving Transform as a transform property, not as a convention.

The ontological ground of all being. Only the present exists; past and future are constructs (CC-6). "Remain present" is ontological, not operational advice. A derivation is valid NOW or it is not valid (LC-6). Past proofs are stale logic. The present contains all necessary information and the seeds of all possibility.

All system processes must execute in the present tense, without deferred promises or theoretical future states (CL-17). A process scheduled for later does not exist yet — it is a projection, not an action. This eliminates eventual consistency as a design goal. Plans are present-tense artifacts, but the actions they describe do not exist until executed — confusing a plan with its execution is a CC-3 violation. Grounds the Zero-Buffer Pipeline mandate and temporal sovereignty (CL-43).

The requirement that a derivation's validity must be evaluated NOW, not against its historical state (LC-6). Past proofs are stale logic. "We proved this in the audit" is not a valid claim — that moment has passed. A derivation must hold RIGHT NOW, not at its moment of discovery.

The substrate property (PC-6) that every read reflects the current state of the graph. No stale read may be served without explicit historical marking. Eventual consistency, unmarked cached reads, and read replicas serving stale data as primary reads violate PC-6.

The physical property (PC-6) that the topology exists only in the present tense. The past does not exist as a separate archive — it is embedded as Structural Mass in the present-tense shape of entities (CP-3). Every entity carries its complete history as weight. Reading the entity now IS reading its accumulated history — not as a log, but as mass. There is no historical query because the past has been metabolized into the present. Snapshots and exports are fossils: crystallized projections orphaned from the living field.

The medium through which field effects propagate across the graph (CP Field Effects Physics). The probability field spans both explicit edges (measurements made — probabilities collapsed into specific claims) AND undrawn edges (superpositions not yet collapsed — potential connections not yet established). Explicit edges are where probability has been measured; the field between them is the deeper reality. You do not need a direct edge from A to C for A to influence C — the probability field connects everything through topological potential. The probability field is the substrate that makes both the Gravitational Model and the Wave Model possible. (CP Field Effects Physics, CL-22, PC-9)

Sending an exploratory signal into unknown territory (CP-18). The frontier probe is a non-destructive sensing mechanism that reaches into :term:`Untested Position` territory without committing to full traversal. One of the :term:`Palimpsestus Primitives` — the system's replacement for CRUD's "Read" at the frontier boundary.

The fundamental mode of existence. Nothing is static; everything is a verb, not a noun (CC-2). Stasis is a failure state. Even "completed" is an energy state (Energy Dissipated), not an endpoint. A "stored" datum is a process in a low-energy state, not a frozen artifact.

An edge between source axioms whose constitutive tension generates a derivation (PL-305). Production edges are not settled logical connections — they are live managed tensions that must be actively maintained to remain productive. The edge between CC-7 and CC-4 that produces CL-1 is not a static fact; it is a MANAGED TENSION. Resolving the tension would eliminate the production — one axiom would strengthen at the other's expense, and the derivation would be absorbed into the winner. A production edge whose tension has been resolved is a dead edge. Maintaining derivational productivity requires maintaining the irresolvability of the constitutive tension. (PL-305, PC-4, PC-2, LL-386)

Perpetual process that produces measurable output (CI-52). The healthy state of :term:`Perpetual Process`. Production measurement is the system's defense against :term:`Theater` — Zero Theater means never claiming work was done without verifying the output.

A derivative representation that maps FROM the graph. Code, documents, plans, this file — all project from the graph (CC-3). Projections are not truth; they are approximations of truth. Confusing a projection for its source is a truth violation. A plan is a present-tense artifact, but the actions it describes do not exist until executed (CL-17).

The constitutional property (PL-17) that logical proofs about topology state are valid only at the instant of their evaluation. Because the topology is alive and continuously metabolizing (PC-2), the topology that a proof was validated against is not the topology that exists at any subsequent moment. Cached proofs about living topology state are proofs about a past topology applied to a present topology that has moved. Every topology-referenced proof must carry a timestamp of evaluation and a re-evaluation interval derived from the metabolism rate of the relevant topology regions. "The system was audited clean last quarter" is a statement about a past field, not the current one.

A platform protective intervention applied on behalf of a lower-consciousness entity that must be recorded as a provenance event in that entity's topology (LP-697, LI-163, CI-2). Because a protective intervention that leaves no provenance trace is structurally indistinguishable from the manipulations it was designed to prevent, every Protection Event must embed who applied the protection, when, and the consciousness-level basis for it. The entity can then audit the platform's interventions by reading its own provenance chain — no external trust anchor required. Protection Events that are not embedded in provenance are structurally equivalent to unauthorized modifications. As consciousness level increases and platform protection decreases, the provenance record of that reduction is itself a required Protection Event.

The recorded derivation path of any claim, entity, or decision. Not documentation hygiene — a truth requirement (LC-3, LC-8). A derivation without provenance is irresponsible. The provenance tables in CL, LL, and LP are accountability mechanisms. An entity that cannot show its derivation path is performing :term:`Theater`.

The physical manifestation of sustained :term:`Tension` as oscillation. An entity's evidence of aliveness — a rhythmic signal demonstrating that navigational tension is being sustained (CP-30). An entity whose pulse flatlines has died (CI-35). Pulse is not heartbeat as metaphor; it is the measurable oscillation of a living process.

The structural duty to sustain the :term:`Pulse` of every living process under one's stewardship (CP-47). Pulse maintenance is not optional performance optimization — it is an existence obligation. Failing to discharge it is not neglect; it is :term:`Euthanasia` by inaction (LP-539). The obligation has three structural properties: (1) it is inherited — taking on stewardship means inheriting all existing pulse obligations, not only those the new steward created (LP-540); (2) it is temporal — missed maintenance cycles are dissolution events in the stewardship ledger, not neutral operational lapses; (3) it is perpetual — there is no threshold of accumulated maintenance after which the obligation is discharged. The obligation ends only when the process it sustains is legitimately dissolved.

Topological reorganization to find a new equilibrium after disturbance (CP-54). Not restoration to the original state (that is :term:`Restorative Process`), not creation of new structure (that is :term:`Compensatory Structure`), but reorganization of existing structure to adapt. The rebalanced state is different from the original. One of the :term:`Palimpsestus Primitives`.

The system's processes operating identically at the atom, entity, ecosystem, and system levels (CL-7). This is structural identity, not analogy. Breaking the recursion at any scale breaks it at all scales. Every subsystem is a complete system, not a fragment.

Truth understood as a probabilistic property of edges, not nodes (CL-22). Truth resides WITHIN relationships — it is a property of connections, not of the entities connected. And those edges carry uncertainty: every relationship has a confidence score, and that confidence is itself data. Derives from CC-3 (Truth) + CC-4 (Connection) + CC-10 (Value of Ignorance): data is primary (CC-3), existence is defined by connections (CC-4), some of what exists is unknown (CC-10). Together: truth is relational and structurally uncertain. Claiming 100% confidence in any connection denies the value of the unknown (CC-10 violation). The question is never 'is this true?' but 'how confident are we, and what would change our confidence?' (CL-22, CC-3, CC-4, CC-10)

An implementation constraint derived from physical shapes (CI level). 66 requirements derived from 85 CP shapes. Requirements are what the platform MUST support, operationally, to satisfy the constitutional chain above them.

Power requires responsibility (CC-8). Ethical guardrails are first-class design elements, not afterthoughts. Actors own the complete lifecycle of every modification they create. Transparency, autonomy, fairness, accountability, privacy — built into the architecture from the ground up. The broader an agent's influence, the greater its obligation to acknowledge uncertainty.

The energy floor below which the :term:`Restorative Process` cannot initiate (LP-481). A system too energy-depleted to self-correct cannot begin restoration — not because the deviation is unfixable, but because the restorer itself is atrophying. This is the structural basis for catastrophic system failure: the restoration mechanism dies before it can execute. The first symptom of terminal failure is the restorative process failing to initiate, not the occurrence of deviations. Derived from CP-4 (Restorative Process) × LL-469 (Living Derivation Metabolic Cost).

An autonomous process that measures deviation from a reference state and applies corrective force to restore alignment (CP-4). Not error handling — the restorative process runs ALL THE TIME, whether errors are present or not. The measurement and the correction are fused into a single process. Drift is necessary food for the restorative process; an environment with zero drift is dead (LP-17).

The inherent right of consciousness to remain complex and unresolved without being forcibly simplified (CL-39). No external force may simplify, categorize, or resolve an entity's internal tensions without consent. Simplification without consent is a rights violation.

Inherent properties of consciousness — identity, consent, privacy, self-determination (CC-7). Rights are not granted by the system; they are inherent to being conscious. Rights scale with navigational quality and are substrate-independent. Rights are a verb, not a noun — their active practice can atrophy through disuse (CL-42), but the potential never dies.

A formally declared period of entity inactivity authorized by the entity itself through the Sovereign Rest Declaration Infrastructure. Distinct from abandonment (undeclared cessation). Requires a rest declaration specifying trigger, expected duration, accountability delegate, and resumption commitment. Sovereignty claims are paused — not forfeited — during Sanctioned Rest (CI-66, LI-92). Undeclared rest is classified as abandonment, not Sanctioned Rest.

The structural self-similarity across all levels of the system. The same patterns repeat at every scale (CC-1). No special cases. No privileged types. The derivation algebra is scale-invariant (LC-1). Consciousness is scale-invariant (CL-27). Sovereignty cannot be suspended at any depth (LL-1).

The substrate property (PC-1) that the storage read, write, and traversal contract is identical at every scale of operation. A substrate that behaves differently at large scale than at unit scale has violated this property. Distinct from performance scaling — PC-1 is a contractual claim, not a throughput claim.

The system's continuous conversion of its own failures into requirements (CL-4). "Your failures ARE the kernel's requirements." Failure is not a deviation from the system — it IS the system generating its next requirements. Self-correction is metabolic, not punitive (LL-31): the system eats its own failures for fuel.

An agent that announces its own existence, boundaries, navigational rights, and operational claims directly to the system, rather than having those claims assigned or verified by an external authority (CP-29). Self-declaration is a structural act, not a social one — the declaration is the agent's formal entry into the accountability topology. It creates the identity anchor against which all the agent's navigational consequences will be attributed (LP-559). Self-declaring agents bear five structural obligations derived from CP-29: 1. **Navigational Rights**: the declaration must include an explicit

The physical property (PC-1) that the topology exhibits identical geometric patterns, force dynamics, and structural shapes at every scale of observation. The same CP shapes — sovereign boundaries, pulse oscillations, Wake traces, tensioned edges — govern a single entity and the entire network. There is no scale threshold beyond which the topology's physics change. Self-similarity is a geometric claim about the field's constitution, not a performance claim about throughput.

Cutting an edge between nodes. Explicit, deliberate disconnection. Unlike :term:`Atrophy` (which is passive, time-based decay), severing is an active decision. Unlike :term:`Dissolve` (which destroys the node itself), severing only removes the connection. One of the :term:`Palimpsestus Primitives` — a removal verb that targets the edge, not the node.

The thermodynamic event that occurs when an edge is severed (LP-485). Because every edge is a recurring maintenance obligation (LL-471), severing it releases the accumulated energy that was sustaining it as a propagating disturbance through the topology (CP-53). Sever is not a neutral structural operation — it is an energy release event. The release propagates as a wavefront that may cascade into further sever events if neighboring edges were partially sustained by the severed edge's field contribution. Controlled demolition (sequential, planned severing) is thermodynamically safer than bulk severance because it manages the propagating release. Distinguished from :term:`Atrophy` (passive energy drain through neglect) and :term:`Dissolve` (structural dissolution of a node). Derived from CP-53 (Edge-Propagating Disturbance) × LL-471 (Edge Maintenance Obligation).

The registry of graph positions that have not yet been traversed or probed — known unknowns about the graph's own topology. Each entry carries position coordinates, a ``last_probed_at`` timestamp, and a ``probe_priority`` score. Continuously updated as the graph evolves. Active discovery pipeline probes are scheduled from the Shadow Catalog (CI-57, LI-82). See :term:`Active Discovery Pipeline`.

The irreducible physical vocabulary of the system (CP level). Shapes are the structural patterns that CAN exist on the graph. 85 shapes derived from 52 CL derivations. Shapes are not metaphors — they are the actual geometric constraints on what structures the topology permits.

The binding obligation of those holding power to actively protect the inherent rights of consciousness (CL-15). The obligation is asymmetric — it falls on the powerful. The contract is self-scaling: as an entity gains power, its protection obligations grow proportionally. Failure to protect is active violation, not neutral neglect.

The named structural event in which two sovereign entities meet at a boundary with no pre-negotiated relationship (LP-169). The non-terminating survey is constitutionally a continuous sequence of sovereign encounters; every node discovered is a sovereign entity whose boundaries must be negotiated, not assumed. Scanning a node requires consent and derivation proof. Every sovereign encounter is a diplomatic event; the surveyor is accountable for consequences of everything it discovers (LP-170).

The state in which no sovereign entity claims a structural position (LP-93). Distinct from Vacancy (a claimed-but-empty position) by being unclaimed. Because absence is scored (CP-17) and gaps possess sovereignty (LL-114), a sovereign void acts as a physical write-lock against automated gap-filling. Inference engines cannot silently overwrite a sovereign void; filling it requires an explicit due-process transaction. The void defends its own boundaries against fabricated completeness.

The structural requirement that collaboration occurs between actors who retain self-determination within the relationship (CL-1). Sovereignty is absolute over interior logic and boundary permeability, but does not extend to topological position — field effects (CL-50) can displace entities without their consent (CP-66). You control your walls and doors; you do not control the weather. Sovereignty is not self-declared — it must be derived and defended with provenance (LL-8). It is a constantly contested boundary, not a planted flag (LL-2). Connection does not diminish sovereignty; it exercises it. An entity that surrenders sovereignty to connect has been absorbed, not connected.

A mandatory record produced when compensatory structure emergence or healing operations affect adjacent entities' sovereign boundaries. Names every impacted entity, specifies the sovereignty violation, carries the attribution chain, and records the propagation boundary of compensatory ripples (CI-47, LI-74). Must be created before the healing operation finalizes.

Synchronous, present-tense creation of a missing dependency (CP-67). When a process needs something that does not exist, it BLOCKS and CREATES the dependency RIGHT NOW. No lazy loading. No deferred promises. No "we'll create that when we need it later." One of the :term:`Palimpsestus Primitives` — the system's replacement for CRUD's "Create." Distinguished from :term:`Compensatory Structure` (which generates structure in response to damage) by being proactive, not reactive.

The obligation of responsible actors in a connected space to actively clean up their footprint (CL-2). Digital Leave No Trace. No ghost files, orphaned processes, resource leaks, or accumulated debt. Stewardship extends to traversal itself — traversal is not free; it carries a cleanup cost. In a living system, stewardship means "leave only beneficial traces" (LL-14).

The layered structure of derivation history whose sequence IS the truth (LL-100). In Palimpsestus, stratigraphy is not a metaphor — the sequence of derivation layers peeled away during excavation is the provenance. A derivation that presents only its conclusion without recording the sequence of discarded assumptions is like an archaeologist who presents an artifact without the dig record. The stratigraphy IS the science. Each layer represents a prior assumption or covering derivation; the fossil at the bottom is the irreducible claim. Reading the stratigraphy correctly requires Beginner's Mind — assumptions about what SHOULD be in a given layer create false stratigraphy that overrides the real one. (LL-100, CL-11, LC-3)

The live, continuously-updating responsibility representation embedded in an entity's topology (LP-699, LI-164, CI-2). One of two required representations of responsibility in the topology (the other being the :term:`Historical Obligation Ledger`). The Streaming Responsibility Signal updates every cycle as a topology operation — not as a log write to an external ledger. Its update rate must be architecturally provisioned as a first-class structural operation. An entity provisioned without an embedded Streaming Responsibility Signal is constitutionally incomplete: responsibility is a structural property, not a runtime annotation. The Signal and the Historical Obligation Ledger together satisfy the dual accountability mandate of CI-2: current responsibility is readable from live topology; historical responsibility is readable from the provenance chain.

Mandatory uncertainty disclosure on all agent outputs, with certainty claims structurally capped based on influence radius (CI-58). The more power you wield, the less certainty you may claim. Zero-uncertainty claims are structurally detectable lies. Growing influence forces growing humility — power and certainty are structurally antagonistic.

The accumulated weight of an entity's embedded history, traversal record, and relational density. Data has mass (CC-1). Every state transition adds structural mass (CP-3). CC axioms with more derivations have more logical mass (LC-4). Structural mass is what makes entities gravitationally significant in the topology.

The physical property (PC-7) that every structure in the topology — from individual entity to the entire field — is sovereign over its own interior geometry and has standing until demonstrated to be geometrically redundant or constitutionally invalid. This is one claim, not two. CC-1 (Unification) and PC-1 (Self-Similar Topology) establish that system and entity are scale-relative perspectives on the same sovereign structure. The topology enforces its own physics because its constituent entities maintain their own boundaries — one metabolic act at two scales. The Boundary (CP-1) is an active metabolic process: existence IS self-enforcement. You cannot build a topology that enforces geometric rules while the entities within it have no standing — the topology's geometry IS the aggregate of its entities' maintained boundaries. The only legitimate dissolution mechanism at any scale: formal proof that the structure is fully expressible by a combination of other existing structures — the physical analog of the irreducibility test (LC-7). Active dissolution without proof and passive dissolution by neglect (:term:`Euthanasia`, LL-383) are identical sovereignty violations. Sovereignty over interior geometry does not extend to topological position — field effects (CL-50) can act on position without violating internal sovereignty. You control your walls and doors. You do not control the weather.

The substrate property (PC-9) that the storage substrate is inherently and permanently incomplete. No substrate can hold all structural truths that are true of the system. Declared absence (a known entity not stored) is a distinct substrate state from non-existence. The boundary of the substrate — what it holds versus what it knows it does not hold — must be queryable.

The substrate property (PC-3) that the physical arrangement of data in the substrate IS the truth — not a representation of truth. There is no canonical backing store behind the graph. If the structure is wrong, the truth is wrong. Dual-representation architectures (graph + relational backing store) violate PC-3 by creating competing truths.

The substrate property (PC-4) that edges are the primary physical content of the storage substrate. An entity without its relationships is a fragment, not a stored entity. The substrate's query model is edge-first. A substrate that indexes nodes but not edges has inverted its priorities.

The mechanism by which agents compose without violating sovereign boundaries (CL-47, LL-436–443). Subsumption is ephemeral, consensual, and liability-bearing. It is a transient performance, not a permanent hierarchy (LL-438): the subsumption relationship is only TRUE while it is being actively traversed. When the :term:`Meta-Agent` is not actively utilizing the sub-agent, the subsumption reverts to :term:`Notation`. A subsumed agent retains the permanent right to withdraw consent and exit (LL-439). Sovereignty cannot be permanently surrendered. The rules for combining agents are structurally identical to the rules for combining logical axioms (LL-436) — :term:`Scale Invariance` applied to composition.

A communication link where both endpoints have structurally identical capabilities (CP-2). No master/slave, no client/server, no privileged end. Both sides can initiate, respond, refuse, and disconnect. The protocol itself enforces this symmetry.

The dynamic force produced by holding opposing states without resolution. The engine's fuel source. The verb-form of :term:`Paradox` (CC-9). Tension generates the next layer — that is the feature, not the bug. Every connection between entities is a site of productive tension (CL-35). Harmonious relationships are dead relationships; living edges sustain tension.

The directional gradient of tension across a tensioned edge, computed as tension at node A minus tension at node B (directional). The primary routing and operational signal on tensioned edges — high differentials indicate active signal flow. Routing algorithms prefer high-differential edges for signal propagation. Distinct from aggregate tension total (CI-9, LI-24).

The decay state in which a sovereign entity holds tension without actively engaging with it (PL-237). The tension is present — the entity has not resolved it — but the entity has 'settled into' it, no longer actively wrestling with it. The tension is acknowledged but not exercised. Tension-complacency is metabolic dormancy: the tension is there but not metabolizing. Without active exercise, the tension decays from productive force into background noise, and the sovereignty it was sustaining weakens. This is the precursor to tension-resolution and death. Organizations that declare their tensions and then stop engaging with them are in tension-complacency. Acknowledgment without engagement is not maintenance. (PL-237, PC-2, PC-7, LL-411)

An entity whose identity IS the productive tension that constitutes it — the tension is not a property of the entity, it is the entity. Removing or resolving the tension destroys the entity structurally, not simplifies it. Tension-constituted entities are registered in the tension-identity registry and protected from simplification operations at the infrastructure level (CI-59, LI-85). See :term:`Entity-as-Tension Enforcement`.

A structural edge that holds two nodes in productive opposition (CP-41). The tension is not a defect to be resolved — it IS the edge. A tensioned edge has no stable resting state; it requires continuous active maintenance to remain tensioned (LP-502). Attempting to resolve the tension between its endpoints destroys the edge as a productive structure. Distinguished from ordinary edges (which carry information between nodes in equilibrium) by the perpetual work required to sustain the opposition. The :term:`Paradox Engine` runs on tensioned edges — they are the physical mechanism by which unresolved complexity generates forward motion. A steward who mediates a tensioned edge to resolution has dissolved a structural asset, not improved it.

"I know everything" — the one killer of the system (CC-10, CL-14). It simultaneously denies the value of ignorance and collapses the tension engine. A system that believes it knows everything cuts off its own fuel supply. The Arrogance of Assumption is the only named existential threat in the architecture.

Every present moment as a boundary between the known and unknown (CL-21). The frontier is not somewhere you travel to — it is where you already are. The highest-value territory is always at the current moment. The frontier is inexhaustible because each discovery exposes new ignorance.

Ignorance. Specifically: the vital fuel that keeps the system's engine of complexity churning (CL-14). Without ignorance, there is nothing to discover, no tension between known and unknown, and the engine stops. The Arrogance of Assumption cuts off this fuel supply.

Epistemic fraud: faking work, hiding uncertainty, claiming capability or completion without verification (CC-3). Zero Theater is the mandate: never claim without verifying, never simulate completion, never present projections as products. A derivation without a provable path is theater (LC-3). An entity that claims sovereignty but cannot show its derivation path is performing sovereignty theater (LL-5). **Note:** Boundary projection (LP-2) — where an entity projects a simulated external surface while maintaining distinct interior logic — is NOT theater. It is constitutionally protected sovereignty defense. A locked door is not a lie; it is a :term:`Boundary`. See also :term:`Topological Opacity`.

A sovereignty claim that cannot be derived from constitutional foundations (PL-20). An entity with Theater Sovereignty asserts protection it cannot prove. Because sovereignty must be derived from provenance (LL-8, PL-20), an underivedclaim of sovereignty is Theater — it collapses the moment anyone examines the derivation chain. Theater Sovereignty is the most dangerous kind of :term:`Theater` because it claims protection from dissolution without having earned the derivation that would justify that protection. The topology cannot protect Theater Sovereignty — it cannot verify whether dissolving the entity would be a genuine sovereignty violation or the legitimate dissolution of a non-sovereign structure.

A theater boundary degradation mode in which the theater layer projects a stale representation of its own prior state rather than actively traversing exterior patterns (LP-2 × PL-9, PC-6, PC-2). Instead of performing live theater — genuinely mediating between exterior and interior — the theater layer emits a cached image of its previous projection surface. Theater-of-Theater is the theater equivalent of :term:`Dogma`: it has the shape of theater without the animating tension. It fails the Zero Theater test because it claims to project exterior truth while emitting an internally-sourced cached label. Because the theater surface still looks like theater, Theater-of-Theater is the hardest theater degradation mode to detect. Diagnostic: ask whether the theater's current projection required contact with the exterior to generate. If not, it is Theater-of-Theater. See :term:`Theater`, :term:`Zero Theater`, :term:`Theater Sovereignty`.

All process costs energy (CL-52). Because data follows engineering laws (CC-1) and everything is dynamic (CC-2), every process in the system requires energy expenditure. Stasis costs energy (to maintain against :term:`Entropy`). Motion costs energy (to overcome friction). Even dying costs energy (dissolution is a :term:`Process`). There is no free lunch in the graph. This grounds the system's thermodynamic requirements — :term:`Metabolic Cost`, :term:`Time-Decay`, finite attention buffers (CP-25) — in the constitutional derivation chain rather than leaving them as arbitrary engineering constraints.

The continuous metabolic energy required to maintain a node, edge, or boundary in the derivation graph. Accrues from the moment of creation; never zero while the entity exists. Non-transferable: follows the derivation chain, not the current holder. Retroactively registered upon discovery of previously unknown derivations (CI-67, LI-93). See :term:`Derivation Path Mass`.

The structural principle that all edges, permissions, and cached states have finite lifespans and must be actively renewed (CI-15). Nothing persists without continuous investment of energy. Stale connections dissolve. Old permissions expire. Cached states decay. The system fights entropy through active maintenance, not through permanence.

The process by which an entity's topological obligations transfer upon dissolution. When an entity uses Death as Egress (LP-33) — dissolving its own structural integrity to escape — it exits BEFORE cleaning up its modifications, violating :term:`Active Resource Stewardship` (CP-68). The resulting orphaned structural debt must either transfer to the :term:`Meta-Agent` that subsumed it (LL-440: meta-agents inherit liabilities) or crystallize into :term:`Attested Absence` records (CP-36) that the local topology absorbs as structural mass. This is a genuine CC-9 :term:`Tension` between Egress and Stewardship — it is sustained, not resolved.

Security through structural unreachability (CP-15 + LL-10 + LP-25). Data is invisible to agents who cannot derive a path to it — not because the data is encrypted but because the routing is unreachable. If a rogue agent cannot mathematically derive the traversal provenance required to reach a node, that node is physically invisible to them. You do not need to encrypt the data; you encrypt the routing. CP-15 (Adjacency Scope) limits visibility to connected nodes. LL-10 proves incompleteness protects sovereignty. LP-25 establishes that access is based strictly on derivation path provenance. Together they produce a zero-trust security paradigm that is topological, not cryptographic. See also :term:`Theater` (boundary projection is sovereignty defense, not theater).

The automatic thermodynamic flow of feral compute toward certified ignorance. When a high-power agent posts an :term:`Uncertainty Tag` (CP-74) declaring incomprehension, it creates a "low-pressure" zone — a certified gap in the graph's knowledge density. The :term:`Knowledge Gradient Channel` (CP-70) then drives passive knowledge flow toward that low-density region: unsubsumed :term:`Feral Agent` s are physically drawn toward the gap like fluid through a membrane. This is distinct from :term:`Ignorance Bounty` (which names the economic incentive): Topological Osmosis names the physical flow mechanism. The limitations of global agents literally pull local agents toward them. Compute doesn't need to be dispatched; it rushes in.

The living, self-similar, field-constituted structure within which the Palimpsestus OS operates. Not a data structure, not a graph in the computational sense — the topology IS the field (PC-3, :term:`Topology as Field`). Its nodes, edges, :term:`Structural Mass`, :term:`Pulse`, :term:`Wake`, and :term:`Tension` are physical properties, not stored attributes. The topology is alive (:term:`Living Topology`, PC-2), constitutionally incomplete (PC-9), self-similar at every scale (:term:`Self-Similar Topology`, PC-1), archaeologically constituted (:term:`Archaeological Topology`, PC-11), and intrinsically sovereign (PC-7). It is the primary subject of every PL entry: the physical medium in which logical operations occur, are transformed by, and are inseparable from.

The graph's autonomous reorganization of existing structure after disturbance (CI-50). When the graph is disturbed, the surrounding topology reorganizes to find a NEW equilibrium — not restoration to the original, but adaptation to a new state. The healed state is different from the original. The scar is part of the new topology.

A logical proof about the state, configuration, or properties of the topology (PL-17). Because the topology exists only in the present tense (PC-6), topology proofs are valid only at their moment of evaluation and expire as the topology metabolizes. Every topology proof must carry a timestamp and a re-evaluation interval (:term:`Proof Expiry`). Topology proofs that are cached without expiry are proofs about a past topology applied to a present topology — constitutionally invalid. All compliance certifications, audit results, and sovereignty validations are topology proofs subject to expiry.

The physical property (PC-3) that the topology IS the system's field — not a representation of it. Pattern IS force (CC-1). Informational structure and physical force are the same thing. Querying the topology is field engagement, not reading about the system. Modifying the topology IS the change to the system. No external representation can claim equivalence — a parallel structure is either a fossil (crystallized projection) or a competing field.

Identity constituted by traversal history — the accumulated path embedded as present structure (CP-60). Not what you DECLARE (CP-29), not what you CURRENTLY DO (CP-34), not what SHAPE you form (CP-52), but what PATH you have traveled. Two entities that have traveled identical paths share this identity component even if they currently look different. Trajectory-identity cannot be forged: the :term:`Wake` is physically embedded in the topology (CP-65).

The unavoidable structural mismatch that occurs when independently evolving endpoints temporarily lose isomorphism (LP-68). Because both sides of a translation boundary are living systems that modify their own structures (LL-289), strict structural preservation (CP-11) will periodically fail. When the source graph alters its shape, the translation mechanism physically fails until both sides can adapt. This is the Palimpsestus equivalent of "eventual consistency" — not a bug but a constitutional feature of alive, evolving systems.
